The '''GX-8 water vaporator''' was the most common type of [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporator]] used on the arid world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was manufactured by [[Pretormin Environmental/Legends|Pretormin Environmental]].<ref name="NEGWT" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Vaporator_specs.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Vaporator [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]].]]
The GX-8 was a model of [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporator]] manufactured by [[Pretormin Environmental/Legends|Pretormin Environmental]].<ref name="EGWT" /> A roughly cylindrical apparatus that stood between three to five [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="NEGWT" /> the GX-8 projected a low-powered [[ion field]], and employed refrigerated cylinders and chilling bars to cool the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] surrounding the unit. The condensation that was created collected on the chilled surface of the vaporator, and ran down the unit to be collected in a collection chamber.<ref name="EGWT" /> The water was then analyzed, checking for any impurities,<ref name="NEGWT" /> before the moisture was pumped into a large, underground storage tank. The vaporator could create moisture in the most barren, arid environments, where the humidity levels could be as low as 1.35 percent.<ref name="EGWT" />

Vaporators such as the GX-8 were programmed using [[Binary/Legends|binary]]. An integrated control [[Computer/Legends|computer]] could automatically adjust the ionization and refrigeration levels emanating from the GX-8,<ref name="EGWT" /> taking readings from basic [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] installed in the unit.<ref name="NEGWT" /> Local atmospheric conditions were accounted for such as windspeed and temperature,<ref name="EGWT" /> and the computer could alter the intensity of the ion field or the temperature of the chilling bar. Vaporators were designed to operate with a high-level of self-sufficiency, requiring only a small amount of power to run its systems. The GX-8's energy cells were recharged by deployable [[Solar collector/Legends|solar panels]].<ref name="NEGWT" />

Despite being designed to operate in arid and barren environments, sand was the greatest challenge to a vaporator's operation. Sand could block the vaporator's sensors, foul its lubricants and clog the refrigeration machinery. Sand had to be removed on a regular basis, and hours could be spent on cleaning out vaporator's internal mechanisms.<ref name="NEGWT" />

The GX-8 vaporators could gather around one and a half [[Liter/Legends|liters]] of [[Water/Legends|water]] per [[Standard day/Legends|day]], and were spaced at least two hundred and fifty meters apart from each other to achieve this goal. In drier areas, such as near the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] vaporators had to be spaced at least five hundred meters apart to gather the same amount of water.<ref name="EGWT" />

On Tatooine, the GX-8 was the most common model of moisture vaporator used, with [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]] across the desert ranging from [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]] to [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]]. The area around the base of the unit tended to be moist and dark, and was nicknamed the "[[Mushroom/Legends|mushroom]] patch" because [[Vaporator mushroom/Legends|Tatooine mushrooms]] could grow in the sand.<ref name="NEGWT" />

However, these vaporators were difficult to hide from vagrant [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]], [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], and [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]]. Storage tanks were protected with [[security lock]]s, but they could be broken into by [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]] such as [[Gaderffii/Legends|gaderffii]] sticks.<ref name="NEGWT" />
